load_runner_toml_config: load and validate a TOML config file that resolves relative paths, env var keys, and dataset splits for the Gaia2 runner
run_config_cli: run a scenario or dataset from a TOML config file using the run-config CLI command with optional dry-run and retry flags
run_dataset_cli: run a dataset of scenarios against a container image using the run-dataset CLI command with provider, model, and judge configuration
run_single_scenario: run a single scenario JSON file in a container using the run CLI command with provider, model, and judge settings
view_trace_artifacts: generate trace viewer HTML from existing run artifacts using the view CLI command to scan an output directory
